in_sanskrit.name: Ghouse
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain fortress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ghouse एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ghoshana', meaning 'fortress' or 'mountain fortress'. This name is often given to a child born in a mountainous region or to one who is believed to be strong and protected, like a fortress.
